description: This file defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from 'whatsgabycooking.com' pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe details such as name, image, ingredients, instructions, tags, and timing information. The function returns a Promise that resolves with a Recipe object or rejects with an error.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema or class used to structure recipe data, imported from a helper module.

methods.name: whatsGabyCooking
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe information into a Recipe object.
